'''Oleg Ivanovich Betin''' ({{langx|ru|Олег Иванович Бетин}}; 25 August 1950 – 17 June 2023)<ref name="onlinetambov.ru">[https://www.onlinetambov.ru/news/society/umer-eks-gubernator-tambovskoy-oblasti-oleg-betin/ Умер экс-губернатор Тамбовской области Олег Бетин] {{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>[http://www.minsport.gov.ru/documents/awards/5150/ Приказ Минспорта России от 30 октября 2013 года № 147-нг «О награждении ведомственными наградами Министерства спорта Российской Федерации».]</ref> was a [[governor]] of [[Tambov Oblast]] in Russia. He was a member of [[Our Home – Russia]] party. In 1995 he became governor.<ref>[http://www.cityline.ru:8084/politika/vybory/rre95t.html Cityline] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050322041954/http://www.cityline.ru:8084/politika/vybory/rre95t.html |date=22 March 2005 }}</ref> He was re-elected on 7 December 2003 with around 70% of the votes cast.<ref>[http://www.rulers.org/2003-12.html December 2003]</ref> Under Betin, Tambov Oblast provided food shipments to war-torn [[Chechnya]] in 2000.<ref>[http://www.hro.org/war/169.htm Права человека в России] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060614145722/http://hro.org/war/169.htm |date=14 June 2006 }}</ref>

Betin died from cancer on 17 June 2023, at the age of 72.<ref name="onlinetambov.ru"/>

== Family ==
Betin is married,<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=BFM.ru |title=Тамбовский губернатор в 2010 году заработал 3,9 млн рублей |url=https://www.bfm.ru/news/136833 |access-date=2024-06-19 |website=BFM.ru - деловой портал |language=ru}}</ref> and has two children and three grandchildren. In his free time, he enjoys carpentry and gardening [source not cited for 4198 days].

His wife, Tamara Petrovna Betina,<ref name=":1" /> heads the Tambov Regional Public Foundation for the Revival of Orthodox Shrines.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Голунов |first=Иван |date=13 January 2011 |title=Высокопоставленные наследники – 2 |url=http://slon.ru/russia/vysokopostavlennye_nasledniki_2-418363.xhtml?r=1001&g=14#Table |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140308003646/http://slon.ru/russia/vysokopostavlennye_nasledniki_2-418363.xhtml?r=1001&g=14#Table |archive-date=8 March 2014 |website=Slon.ru}}</ref>

His son, Vyacheslav Olegovich Betin (born 1980), has led several businesses in Tambov (such as City Design Bureau LLC and Real LLC). In 2005, he was elected a deputy of the Tambov City Duma. Since 2006, he has been the majority owner (68% of the charter capital) and CEO of a large construction holding — Tambov Investment Company LLC, which includes Tambov Design Institute LLC, Tambov Construction Company LLC, Tambov Reinforced Concrete Plant LLC, and TKS Center Management Company LLC.<ref name=":2" />

His daughter, Ekaterina Olegovna Betina, graduated from Tambov State University.<ref name=":2" />

== Controversies ==
One episode of the “Special Correspondent” program on the Russia-1 TV channel focused on abuses in the housing and utilities sector of the city of Tambov. The main subjects of this journalistic investigation were the governor of the region Oleg Betin, his son Vyacheslav Betin, deputy Andrey Popov, and ordinary residents of the city.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Мамонтов |first=Аркадий |date=21 October 2016 |title=Специальный корреспондент. Коррупция. Часть 2. ЖКХ |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FyQ-soyxY9g |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200119034831/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FyQ-soyxY9g |archive-date=19 January 2020 |website=Youtube}}</ref>

== Scandals ==
One episode of the program ''Special Correspondent'' on the Russia-1 television channel focused on abuses in the housing and utilities sector of the city of Tambov. The main figures featured in the investigative report were the region's governor Oleg Betin, his son Vyacheslav Betin, deputy Andrey Popov, and local residents.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Специальный корреспондент. Коррупция. Часть 2. ЖКХ. Аркадий Мамонтов. |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FyQ-soyxY9g |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200119034831/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FyQ-soyxY9g |archive-date=2020-01-19 |website=youtube}}</ref>
